articles.author: Khyathi Dalal
articles.headline: Bitcoin Bear Market Over? Not Quite. Analyst Says $83,000 Is The Real Test
articles.summary: It's too early to declare the Bitcoin bear market bottom, but $83,000 could confirm a trend change, one analyst says.
articles._summary: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) has broken above $65,000 and is testing its previous high near $67,260. However, one crypto analyst says it is too early to declare that the bear-market bottom is in. In a podcast on July 22, analyst Jason Pizzino said the market’s structure began improving in late June and early July. That is when Bitcoin recovered despite widespread negativity surrounding crypto markets and treasury companies.
articles._zh_headline: 比特币熊市结束？不完全是。分析师称 83,000 美元是真正的考验
articles._zh_summary: 比特币（CRYPTO：BTC）已突破 65,000 美元，并正在测试其前高点 67,260 美元附近。然而，一位加密货币分析师表示，现在宣布熊市底部已经到来还为时过早。分析师 Jason Pizzino 在 7 月 22 日的播客中表示，市场结构在 6 月底和 7 月初开始改善。尽管加密货币市场和财务公司普遍存在负面情绪，但比特币还是在那时复苏了。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: SPY, QQQ And SOXL Power ETF Trading To New Record
articles.summary: Leveraged ETFs joined SPY and QQQ in driving ETF trading to a record high, reflecting the rising influence of leveraged and index ETFs.
articles._summary: ETF volume hit an all-time high of 27.6%, according to IEX’s latest data. That’s up sharply from the high teens and low 20s that prevailed for much of the past decade. The milestone points to a broader change in market behavior. Rather than trading individual stocks, many investors are now turning to ETFs, particularly leveraged and inverse funds, to make bullish or bearish bets on sectors, themes, or even single companies.
articles._zh_headline: SPY、QQQ 和 SOXL Power ETF 交易再创新高
articles._zh_summary: IEX 的最新数据显示，ETF 成交量创下 27.6% 的历史新高。与过去十年的大部分时间里盛行的十几岁和二十多岁的人相比，这一数字急剧上升。这一里程碑表明市场行为发生了更广泛的变化。许多投资者现在不再交易个股，而是转向 ETF，特别是杠杆基金和反向基金，对行业、主题甚至单个公司进行看涨或看跌押注。

articles.headline: QUICK SPARK: China's EV Price War Can't Last Forever– 'Unsustainable' GM CEO Says
articles.summary: GM CEO Mary Barra called China's EV price war "unsustainable," arguing the market needs consolidation - why Tesla investors should care..
articles._summary: Speaking on GM’s second-quarter earnings call, Barra described the pricing environment in China as “unsustainable,” arguing that the country’s overcrowded EV market will eventually need a major shakeout. “There’s intense pricing competition that frankly is unsustainable in China,” she said, adding that “there’s so many competitors” and “a lot of sorting that’s going to happen, need to happen for long-term viability.”

articles._zh_headline: SK 海力士否认英特尔俄亥俄州收购报告：“我们没有收购计划”（已更新）
articles._zh_summary: 韩国《中央日报》报道称，SK 海力士正在谈判收购俄亥俄州工厂，以便在五年内在美国建立前端存储芯片生产基地，之后，SK 海力士在韩国交易所提交的文件中做出了澄清。 SK海力士在文件中表示，它“正在不断审查出于商业目的的各种投资和收购机会”，但补充说，它“尚未寻求或决定收购英特尔俄亥俄州工厂和晶圆厂”。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: Elon Musk Needs to 'Shore Up Credibility,' Stop Making 'Outlandish' Promises, Says Gary Black Ahead of Tesla's Q2 Earnings
articles.summary: Investor Gary Black slams Tesla CEO Elon Musk's Robotaxi promises, says company needs better communication and credibility.
articles._summary: He shared that while GM and Ford’s autonomous efforts were not superior to Tesla’s, “Elon keeps making outlandish promises” like Tesla Robotaxis serving 50% of the U.S. population by the end of last year. “The comms at TSLA are sorely lacking and @elonmusk needs to bring on 1-2 adults to shore up credibility,” the investor said, delivering sharp criticism of the company, as well as its lack of communications and PR.
articles._zh_headline: 加里·布莱克在特斯拉第二季度财报公布前表示，埃隆·马斯克需要“增强可信度”，停止做出“古怪”的承诺
articles._zh_summary: 他表示，虽然通用汽车和福特在自动驾驶方面的努力并不比特斯拉优越，但“埃隆不断做出一些奇怪的承诺”，比如特斯拉机器人出租车到去年年底将为 50% 的美国人口提供服务。这位投资者表示：“TSLA 的沟通非常缺乏，@elonmusk 需要聘请 1-2 名成年人来增强可信度。”他对公司以及缺乏沟通和公关提出了尖锐的批评。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: Elon Musk Denies Report Claiming Foxconn Won $52 Billion SpaceX AI Server Deal: 'This Is Fake News'
articles.summary: Elon Musk rejected claims SpaceX awarded Foxconn a $52B billion AI server contract, saying the report was "fake news."
articles._summary: Musk responded to an X user who shared the report and said, “Jesus that’s a lot of compute,” replying, “This is fake news.” Foxconn and SpaceX did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s requests for clarification. “If Supermicro did that well, Dell should be incredible,” Cramer said in a post on X. Dell is scheduled to report fiscal year 2027 second quarter earnings on September 3.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克否认有关富士康赢得 SpaceX 520 亿美元人工智能服务器交易的报道：“这是假新闻”
articles._zh_summary: 马斯克在回复一位分享该报告的 X 用户时表示，“天哪，这需要大量的计算”，并回答道：“这是假新闻。”富士康和 SpaceX 没有立即回应 Benzinga 的澄清请求。克莱默在 X 上发帖称：“如果超微做得这么好，戴尔应该会令人难以置信。”戴尔定于 9 月 3 日公布 2027 财年第二季度收益。
